not_found.title: Page not found
not_found.description: The page you requested doesn't exist, was moved, or the link may be outdated.

something_went_wrong.title: Something went wrong
something_went_wrong.description: An unexpected error occurred while loading this page. You can try again, or return to a safe page.

server_error.title: Server unavailable
server_error.description: The signal dropped between here and the server. It may be restarting or temporarily unreachable — this is usually resolved within a minute.
